lines.text: AMC eight challenge! Think it's one in six? Nope!
lines.caption: AMC 8 challenge! Think it's 1 in 6? Nope!

lines.text: Roll three fair dice, and put the numbers in order.
lines.caption: Roll 3 fair dice, and put the numbers in order.

lines.text: What's the probability that the middle one is a two?
lines.caption: What's the probability that the middle one is a 2?

lines.text: Sort all two hundred sixteen rolls by how many dice show a two.
lines.caption: Sort all 216 rolls by how many dice show a 2.

lines.text: A single two: a one below, three to six above. Six orders, times four. Twenty-four!
lines.caption: A single 2: a 1 below, 3 to 6 above. 6 orders, times 4. 24!

lines.text: A pair of twos: three spots for the odd die, times five. That's fifteen.
lines.caption: A pair of twos: 3 spots for the odd die, times 5. That's 15.

lines.text: Forty out of two hundred sixteen. That's five over twenty-seven!
lines.caption: 40 out of 216. That's 5/27!

lines.text: One in six was the trap. It's one die showing a two.
lines.caption: 1 in 6 was the trap. It's one die showing a 2.

lines.text: Did you get five over twenty-seven? Tell me below!
lines.caption: Did you get 5/27? Tell me below!
